raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly asserted that King Cheng of Zhou’s mother was Queen Tai Si, conflating Tai Si (consort of King Wen and thus Cheng’s grandmother) with Yi Jiang (consort of King Wu and Cheng’s mother). This misreading contradicted prior WebSurfer results showing Yi Jiang and would lead to the wrong identification of King Kang’s paternal grandmother.
